fetchLines: You remember the Stone knife at your space in the haven and fetch it — it rides in your pack now.

fullDaySay: You push through the doors into open air. Haven grounds — tents, a fire pit, worn paths. The world is that way.
You break ground behind the hall — bed 1 of 2, turned and ready. Sow seed to start a crop.
You break ground behind the hall — bed 2 of 2, turned and ready. Sow seed to start a crop.
💧 A person, maybe 40s returns with water: +2 clean.
💧 A woman, maybe 30s, with a buzz cut returns with water: +2 clean.
💧 A woman, maybe 30s, with a nervous tic returns with water: +3 clean.

"Hey." A person, maybe 60s, with sun-creased eyes settles near you, not too close. "Day one. Everyone's pretending they're fine. ...Can we talk? Just talk — like people used to." (Talk to A person, maybe 60s, with sun-creased eyes.)
Recipe: Bark armor (Level 1). You have seen bark armor. Plates of bark laced together, worn like a shell.

🛡️ Dawn at Haven. By the fire hangs an old bark cuirass, split at the seam — somebody's grandfather wore this into the treeline and came back. The shape of it is clear: bark plates laced overlapping like shingles, vine cord. Your hands don't know it yet. Your eyes do.
⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. You went to bed on an empty stomach.
Village meal: +1200 kcal, +1L water from the communal pantry. (Half ration — they don't trust you yet.)
A woman, maybe 50s traded something with someone for something else. The barter economy stirs.
You remember the Stone knife at your space in the haven and fetch it — it rides in your pack now.
You remember the Leather jacket at your space in the haven and fetch it — it rides in your pack now.
📓 Journal: the woman in her 30s, with a buzz cut taught the person in their 40s Mediation.
📓 Journal: the person in their 60s, with sun-creased eyes taught the man in his 50s Soft Step.
🤒 Morgan is achy and wrung out, barely eating. Rest and clean water — or it gets worse. A woman, maybe 50s is already boiling water. It's handled.
🔧 Technique learned: tick removal.
A woman, maybe 50s watches you scratch at your ankle and shakes their head. “Here — tweezers at the head, steady pull, don’t twist. Like this.” (You learned tick removal.)
— DAY 2 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
👀 Someone asks the man in his 20s, the bus driver a shop-talk question about bus driver work. The pause before the answer is long enough to hear.
📓 Journal: jotted down what they said (A man, maybe 20s).
👀 the woman in her 20s was talking about home — then stopped mid-sentence, recalibrated, and said "Denver" just a fraction too deliberately. Whatever home is, it isn't where that sentence started.
📓 Journal: jotted down what they said (A woman, maybe 20s).
Jamal Aquino reads the sky: clear tomorrow, cold.
A person, maybe 50s will work the garden once each day while at Haven. Other orders take priority.
You step into the Haven hall.
📋 A man, maybe 50s — 🎣 Fish. (a natural — good pick) They'll report back by next part.
"Got it," A person, maybe 50s says flatly. "Orders are orders. Whoever gives them."
📋 A person, maybe 50s — 🎣 Fish. They'll report back by next part.
(Talking costs a little energy — 10 kcal a conversation. Small talk is cheap; going deep costs time, not more food.)
Hunger gnaws. The pack is thin — work the green, haul it back, get it named at camp. That's the whole game.
"Chloe," they say, touching their chest. "I'm Chloe." You'll remember that.
📓 Journal: learned their name (Chloe).
...and then it lands: A woman, maybe 40s speaks 🇺🇸 English. A few shared words. Gestures. Patience.
"Luca," they say, touching their chest. "I'm Luca." You'll remember that.
📓 Journal: learned their name (Luca).
"Theo," they say, touching their chest. "I'm Theo." You'll remember that.
📓 Journal: learned their name (Theo).
You eat Dried meat and Trail mix (1400 kcal).
You take 4 logs from the woodpile for the road home. (11 left for the hearth.)

Travel 1 tile to grove.
— Nut trees —
The trees here fruit on their own schedule. Right now the schedule is generous.
Something moves out there — a raccoon with too many fingers, working at something.
Something big is moving in the woods. The birds went quiet.
Unfamiliar unknown nuts — into the bag. (Unknowns lump together; sort them at camp.)
Unfamiliar unknown shoots — into the bag. (Unknowns lump together; sort them at camp.)
Unfamiliar unknown roots — into the bag. (Unknowns lump together; sort them at camp.)
Journal: Riparian ground. Water means life, and lunch.
📓 Journal: you UNDERSTAND **Green Thumb, Literally**. It resonates with: something unnamed, something unnamed.

A shot in the dark — you take what's green: 4× unknown nuts, 4× unknown shoots, 3× unknown roots. Into the bag, unnamed. (Not food until identified — sort them at camp.) This patch is picked clean — it'll recover in a few days.
Travel 1 tile to Haven.
The raccoon with too many fingers stops at the treeline — pacing, unwilling. The walls end the argument. It's still out there.
3 unprocessed hauls onto the counter — the clock is ticking.
Someone by the fire nods at the counter. "We pool food here. Keep what you need for the road — the rest feeds everyone, once it's food."
Nobody at the fire knows your haul any better than you do. It'll be your own hands that teach you.
You walk back into Haven. 3 Codex entries. The village is glad to see you.
A person, maybe 50s picks through the bag, frowning. Nothing they can name with confidence. (8 ticks)

★ IDENTIFIED: Sassafras. Mitten-shaped leaves — three shapes on one tree. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
💡 Sassafras. The small tree with mitten-shaped leaves (three shapes), spicy root smell you've been looking at for days finally has a name, and now you'll never unsee it.
A man, maybe 60s was watching. Now they know Sassafras too.
A person, maybe 50s spreads the bag on a flat stone and starts naming: Sassafras ★.
You watch closely — Sassafras is yours now too.
The bag is empty. Everything named.

You break ground behind the hall — bed 4 of 4, turned and ready. Sow seed to start a crop.

📣 A man, maybe 60s found a cache out there — enough to matter.
🍲 Theo is eating by the fire — not talking, just eating.
🧳 A traveler passed through yesterday, talking about a village to the northwest called Emberhold. The region is bigger than your fire.
🗣️ A woman, maybe 50s to a person, maybe 60s, with sun-creased eyes, by the fire: "Stone. We need 59 more for the palisade footings. Creek beds, hillsides — pry it loose."

A woman, maybe 50s spends the afternoon with the vine with thick-skinned round fruit — look, smell, the smallest taste, then waiting. An hour passes. Then another. Nothing. The fire nods. That's dinner, maybe.
From the lumped bag: Muscadine Grapes — named, and out.
★ IDENTIFIED: Muscadine Grapes. Muscadine. Thick-skinned wild grapes. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
💡 The vine with thick-skinned round fruit — THAT's what A woman, maybe 50s was describing. Muscadine Grapes. It clicks like a key turning.

You've started noticing: Theo and A man, maybe 60s never speak. It's not new. (Something old lives in Haven.)
— DAY 4 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
Overnight, unknown shoots went bad — beyond saving. You leave it for the flies.
Fresh food keeps days, not weeks. Smoke it over a fire to make it last.
The fire burns low. 2 new lines in the journal tonight — loudest: Sassafras — named and noted.

The pantry is in the hall. Your hands are not.

📖 LEARNED: Gossip Network (Level 1). You hear things. People tell you things. You remember who told you what.
This patch is worked out — step to another green patch and forage again.
A fallen tree blocks the path.

Travel 2 tiles to trail edge.
— An old trail —
A game trail crosses your path — two toes, heart-shaped, heading for water.
It followed you. The raccoon with too many fingers is here.
Movement — a crow watching you from a dead branch, head cocked.
👁 It sees you before you see it, and it tells everyone. Take the shot before the cawing starts — after that, the whole woods knows where you're standing.
You see smoke on the horizon. Thornfield — 9 people, 4 days in. fishing folk, by the look of it. They know 4 plants — 4 new to you. They've been here the whole time.
